name: FormSection
description: One part of a bigger form (a wide dialog or sheet): a small heading with its status and a line on what it is for, then its fields. Consecutive sections are separated by a hairline.

props.name: status
props.description: Where this part stands (Complete, Optional, Off …): a quiet tag.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.
